security_audit.summary: The installation guide contains an unverified remote payload execution command that disables TLS verification and runs downloaded code. It also documents recursive database deletion commands; the remaining static findings are documentation, Markdown formatting, or local verification patterns without evidence of secret exposure.

remediation.issue: Unverified remote payload execution during installation
remediation.suggestion: Remove the curl, base64, and Node.js execution command. Distribute versioned releases with published checksums or signed artifacts, and never disable TLS verification.
Require an explicit confirmation and a backup warning before deletion. Prefer a dedicated reset command that validates the resolved instance path.

remediation.issue: Port termination command may stop an unrelated process
remediation.suggestion: Show the process details and ask users to verify ownership before running kill. Prefer the documented managed dev-runner stop command.

content.user_title: Organize Persistent Memory with PARA Files
content.value_statement: Agents can lose important context when sessions end. This skill stores durable facts, daily notes, and user preferences in a searchable PARA file structure.
actual_capabilities: Creates PARA-style folders for projects, areas, resources, and archives.
Stores durable entity facts in atomic YAML files.
Maintains daily notes as a chronological record.
Records user operating preferences in a dedicated memory file.
Guides semantic and keyword recall with qmd commands.
Keeps project plans separate from personal memory.
limitations: Requires a writable agent home directory and disciplined file maintenance.
Does not install or configure qmd.
Does not guarantee that every fact is current or correct.
Does not provide cloud synchronization or access control.

use_cases.title: Maintain project context
use_cases.description: Record decisions, deadlines, and active facts for ongoing work.

use_cases.title: Track client relationships
use_cases.description: Store durable client preferences and engagement details in organized entity folders.

use_cases.title: Review past conversations
use_cases.description: Search notes and plans when preparing for a new work session.

prompt_templates.title: Save a fact
prompt_templates.prompt: Save this durable fact in the correct PARA entity: Our deployment target is Europe West.

prompt_templates.title: Create project memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PARA project entry for the mobile redesign. Include its goal, deadline, and current facts.

prompt_templates.title: Recall context
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my memory for prior decisions about the billing migration. Summarize only active facts.

prompt_templates.title: Run a memory review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review active memory items for staleness. Update superseded facts and propose a concise weekly summary.

output_examples.input: Remember that Maya prefers weekly written updates.
output: Creates or updates Maya's entity facts.
Records the preference as an active durable fact.

output_examples.input: What did we decide about the launch schedule?
output: Returns a concise summary with the most recent active decision.

output_examples.input: Organize my notes for the analytics project.
output: Creates a project folder in the PARA structure.
Separates durable facts from chronological daily notes.

best_practices: Store only durable facts that will help future work.
Use clear entity names and keep summaries concise.
Review active facts regularly and mark superseded information.
anti_patterns: Do not store secrets or credentials in memory files.
Do not treat old notes as current without checking their status.
Do not create an entity for every short-lived mention.

faq.question: What does PARA mean?
faq.answer: PARA organizes information into Projects, Areas, Resources, and Archives.

faq.question: Where are durable facts stored?
faq.answer: Durable facts are stored in items.yaml files inside entity folders.

faq.question: What are daily notes for?
faq.answer: Daily notes capture a chronological record before durable facts are extracted.

faq.question: Does this skill search files automatically?
faq.answer: It provides qmd commands for semantic, keyword, and vector-based search.

faq.question: Can it store user preferences?
faq.answer: Yes. It maintains tacit knowledge about user patterns in MEMORY.md.

faq.question: Should I store credentials in this memory system?
faq.answer: No. Keep credentials and other secrets out of memory files.
